messages:
maya (docs): hey — I'm about to merge the quota-migration playbook PR but wanted a quick sanity check on two things before I ship:
1) the SDK header example for `x-redwood-usage-tier` (we changed the header name in v4)
2) the embedding panel link (i replaced the panel id but not 100% sure it maps to the new metric name)

jordan (pm): thanks — can you paste the header snippet here? i want to confirm it includes the tier fallback behavior we discussed for free accounts.

maya (docs): sure — current draft snippet:

```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
x-redwood-usage-tier: tier:free
```

notes: i added `tier:free` as the simple example, and a short note about server-side overrides.

sam (eng): two quick things: 1) header name is correct, but the runtime expects `tier=free` (equals) in the router code — we'll accept both `tier:free` and `tier=free` for a week. can you show both examples? 2) panel mapping: the new metric is `metering.embeddings.tokens.total` not the old `embeddings.tokens.count` — panel id i think maps but needs metric rename.

maya (docs): ok will add both formats and a small migration note. would you prefer a sentence like: "Both `tier:free` and `tier=free` are accepted; use `tier=...` for new integrations" ?

jordan (pm): yes that's clearer. also add a short paragraph in the playbook about burst-credit interactions: if a customer has burst credits on older plans, they may see a short-lived allowance applied before tier enforcement. we should link to the pricing page.

maya (docs): added a TODO to include the pricing link and a one-liner about burst credits. drafting now. i also swapped the grafana panel url to the new dashboard but unsure about query variables — link below, can someone confirm it lands on the embeddings tokens panel?

https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/usage-overview?orgId=1&view=embeddings

sam (eng): clicking now — that's the overview, the panel id is 7 for `metering.embeddings.tokens.total`. update the doc link to include `&panelId=7&from=now-7d&to=now`.

maya (docs): perfect, updating. i'll also add a compact SDK snippet for python and node: 

python:
```py
import requests
headers = {
  "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('RW_KEY')}",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "x-redwood-usage-tier": "tier=free"
}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", json={"model":"v-embed-1","input":"hello"}, headers=headers)
```

node:
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-usage-tier': 'tier=free'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'v-embed-1', input: 'hello' })
})
```

jordan (pm): looks great. one more ask: can we include a short note for the billing team about how the panel delta maps to chargeable tokens? they prefer a single-line mapping table.

maya (docs): added a one-line mapping: `metering.embeddings.tokens.total -> billed tokens (post-normalization)` and a link to the consumption guide. i'll ping finance for quick confirmation before merge.

sam (eng): FYI i pushed a tiny validation change to accept `tier:free` format for compatibility; should be in staging in ~5m.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy successful: metering-router v3.14.2 — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

maya (docs): awesome, thanks everyone. i'll wait for finance ack then merge. leaving a note to backport the snippet to the SDK samples repo after merge. :thumbsup:
